errorDetails: Server selection timeout after 30000ms; topology was ReplSetNoPrimary
symptoms: Spike in connection pool wait queues
resolution: Increased connection pool size from 50 to 100 in database config and restarted pods
outcomeNotes: Connection wait times dropped to 12ms. Zero 500 errors recorded for 72 hours post-fix.
lessonsLearned: Default Mongo pool size of 50 is insufficient when traffic surges past 1,200 req/sec.

errorDetails: Server selection timeout after 30000ms: no primary found in replica set rs0
resolution: Updated mongo connection string to include proper replicaSet=rs0 and readPreference=secondaryPreferred
outcomeNotes: Service reconnected in 45 seconds once replica set options were restored.
lessonsLearned: Helm chart deployment omitted replicaSet query param in connection URI template.

errorDetails: Socket timeout waiting for response after 5000ms on socket 10.0.4.12:27017
rootCause: Network packet drop on VPC peering gateway
resolution: Failed over VPC peering routes to secondary gateway interface
lessonsLearned: AWS VPC peering interface had MTU mismatch causing jumbo frames to drop.

errorDetails: jwt signature is required or invalid signature on user token validation
symptoms: 100% of logins failing across all apps
rootCause: JWT secret key mismatch following secret rotation
deploymentInfo: v1.8.2 deployment with HashiCorp Vault auto-sync
resolution: Rolled back Vault secret to previous revision and restarted Auth pods
outcomeNotes: Immediate recovery. Token validation succeeded across all pods.
lessonsLearned: Dual-signing window must be kept active for 24h before old secret retirement.

errorDetails: Redis connection closed abruptly while fetching session store: ECONNRESET
symptoms: Postgres CPU spiked to 98% due to auth fallback
rootCause: Redis memory limit hit (maxmemory-eviction failed on volatile-lru)
deploymentInfo: No recent deployment, Black Friday traffic test
resolution: Expanded Redis cluster node memory from 4GB to 16GB and altered policy to allkeys-lru
outcomeNotes: Eviction latency eliminated and Postgres CPU returned to 18%.
lessonsLearned: Session keys lacked proper TTL expiry causing unbounded growth.

errorDetails: Gateway HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout after 15000ms waiting for upstream partner API
symptoms: Stripe webhooks queuing up past 5,000 backlogged items
rootCause: Upstream partner rate limit triggered due to missing idempotency retry backoff
resolution: Enabled exponential backoff with jitter and reduced concurrent retry workers from 50 to 10
outcomeNotes: Queue drained within 8 minutes. Upstream 429 and 504 rates dropped to 0%.
lessonsLearned: Retries without exponential backoff cause self-inflicted DDoS on third-party APIs.

errorDetails: CommitFailedException: Consumer group orders-stream rebalance in progress for 180s
symptoms: Order status emails delayed by 45 minutes
rootCause: Max poll interval exceeded due to heavy synchronous PDF invoice generation
deploymentInfo: v2.0.4 with new high-res PDF generation module
resolution: Moved invoice generation to asynchronous background BullMQ worker and bumped max.poll.interval.ms from 300000 to 600000
outcomeNotes: Consumer rebalance settled and group remained STABLE. Lag cleared in 12 mins.
lessonsLearned: Never perform heavy CPU blocking operations inside Kafka poll loops.

errorDetails: Primary shard [products_v2][0] failed to allocate: [circuit_breaking_exception] [parent] Data too large
symptoms: Elasticsearch JVM garbage collection pauses exceeding 12s
rootCause: JVM heap exhaustion from unindexed field wildcard aggregation
deploymentInfo: v1.4.0 added fuzzy wildcard query filter
resolution: Rollback search query template to term-based search and cleared Elasticsearch fielddata cache
outcomeNotes: Cluster health transitioned from RED to GREEN within 3 minutes.
lessonsLearned: Wildcard aggregations on high-cardinality fields must be disabled in ES mapping.

errorDetails: Server selection timeout after 30000ms; topology was ReplSetNoPrimary
rootCause: Attempted hot pod restart without checking connection pool metrics
resolution: Blindly restarting pods without pool sizing adjustment failed and exacerbated cold-start storm
outcomeNotes: Restart caused all 40 pods to reconnect simultaneously, crushing the MongoDB router.
lessonsLearned: DO NOT just restart pods for MongoServerSelectionError without inspecting pool exhaustion first.
